what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Madagascar, as recorded by IDMC.
At the end of 2024, IDMC counted 182 people displaced by conflict and violence, while UNHCR's file shows none.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict for Madagascar, so it does not say why people were displaced by violence.
IDMC's disaster records for Madagascar list floods, storms and wildfires.

when.text: In 2024, IDMC recorded 182 new displacements by conflict and violence: these count movements, not people.
IDMC's year-end figure fell from 1982 in 2018; the main years of displacement in the data are 2018 and 2021.

how.text: In 2025, IDMC recorded 176640 new displacements by disasters, also counting movements, not people.
The sources don't say where people went inside Madagascar.
